newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB says regrets Moody's rating review.
newsitem.headline: NCB says regrets Moody's rating review.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) said on Tuesday it regretted a move by Moody's Investors Service to review the bank's Baa3 senior debt rating, including its domestic debentures, for possible downgrade.

An NCB spokesman said the bank believed the review would not lead to a downgrading of the rating. liquidity of our debentures are improving. We believe that the announcement does not mean there will be a downgrade and that it will not lead to a downgrade in the future," the spokesman said.
Moody's said in a statement earlier on Tuesday that it had placed NCB"s Baa3 senior debt rating, including its domestic debentures, under review for possible downgrade.

Moody's said it had also confirmed its Baa3/Prime-3 short-term and long-term deposit ratings and E financial-strength rating for Nippon Credit. The outlook for the deposit ratings remained negative, it added.
While the risks to NCB depositors in the medium term remained low, debenture holders faced "greater risks", Moody"s said.
